en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large Romanesque-style cathedral with four tall corner towers, fronted by a formal garden and statue. The building is set against low hills with surrounding city structures. The front bears printed Hungarian text "PÉCS" at the top left and "Székesegyház" at the top right. The reverse side has divided postcard layout lines, handwritten Hungarian address/message, a green Hungarian postage stamp, and a printed card number along the edge.
